        continue  # Already handled

    original = content
    
    # Replace JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, X) for internal types with WriteObjectValue
    # These types implement IJsonModel: ManagedServiceIdentity, ExtendedLocation, ArmPlan, SubResource
    
    # JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, Identity) or JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, ManagedIdentity)
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Serialize\(writer, (Identity|ManagedIdentity)\)',
        r'writer.WriteObjectValue(\1)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, Plan)
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Serialize\(writer, Plan\)',
        r'writer.WriteObjectValue(Plan)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, ExtendedLocation)
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Serialize\(writer, ExtendedLocation\)',
        r'writer.WriteObjectValue(ExtendedLocation)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, Parent)
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Serialize\(writer, Parent\)',
        r'writer.WriteObjectValue(Parent)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, Error) -> need ResponseError context
    if 'JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, Error)' in content:
        content = content.replace(
            'JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, Error)',
            'writer.WriteObjectValue<ResponseError>(Error)'
        )
        needs_response_error_context.add(filepath)
    
    # JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SystemData>(property.Value.GetRawText())
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<SystemData>\((\w+)\.Value\.GetRawText\(\)\)',
        r'SystemData.DeserializeSystemData(\1.Value)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ManagedServiceIdentity>(property.Value.GetRawText())
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<ManagedServiceIdentity>\((\w+)\.Value\.GetRawText\(\)\)',
        r'ManagedServiceIdentity.DeserializeManagedServiceIdentity(\1.Value)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ExtendedLocation>(property.Value.GetRawText())
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<ExtendedLocation>\((\w+)\.Value\.GetRawText\(\)\)',
        r'ExtendedLocation.DeserializeExtendedLocation(\1.Value)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ArmPlan>(property.Value.GetRawText())
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<ArmPlan>\((\w+)\.Value\.GetRawText\(\)\)',
        r'ArmPlan.DeserializeArmPlan(\1.Value)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Deserialize<SubResource>(property0.Value.GetRawText())
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<SubResource>\((\w+)\.Value\.GetRawText\(\)\)',
        r'SubResource.DeserializeSubResource(\1.Value)',
        content
    )
    
    # JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ResponseError>(property.Value.GetRawText())
    if re.search(r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<ResponseError>', content):
        content = re.sub(
            r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<ResponseError>\((\w+)\.Value\.GetRawText\(\)\)',
            r'ResponseError.DeserializeResponseError(\1.Value)',
            content
        )
        needs_response_error_context.add(filepath)
    
    # JsonSerializer.Deserialize<OperationStatusResult>(item.GetRawText())
    content = re.sub(
        r'JsonSerializer\.Deserialize<OperationStatusResult>\((\w+)\.GetRawText\(\)\)',

    if content != original:
